votes.motion: To approve Minutes from the May 13, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting as presented
To approve application #CUP2020-000064 requesting Final Conditional Use approval for a Warehouse/Office building on Lot 1 of the proposed 201 Logistics Center Subdivision with staff recommendations

To approve application #CUP2021-000286 requesting Conditional Use approval for a canal trail from 7200 West until approximately 7988 West Molly Drive (east of 8000 West) with three staff recommendations
To approve application #CUP2021-000306 requesting Conditional Use approval for a new fire station with five staff recommendations

To approve application #CUP2021-000321 requesting approval to modify his original Conditional Use permit to allow a 3,200 square foot carport to be placed on the used car lot site with two staff recommendations and one additional condition exclusion of auto repair or dismantling on the carport pad

To approve application #PAM2021-000298 requesting approval to amend his Conditional Use for a PUD Subdivision to allow for a density of up to 9 units per acre. The applicant proposes to amend the PUD Plat, Phase #3 to allow ten additional lots with eight staff recommendations
